tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm ink in Encre, paper in Papier.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, menus, the result card.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover fill, raised rows, key chips, follow-up question bubbles.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines, dividers, input and secondary-button borders.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and correctly typed passage letters. 14.3:1 (Encre) and 14.1:1 (Papier) on bg.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Labels, live stats, metadata, hints. 6.4:1 and 5.3:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text-untyped
tokens.usage: Passage letters not yet typed. Large text only (22px+): 3.4:1 and 3.2:1 on bg.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ink blue: the caret, primary buttons, links, selected segments. 8.3:1 and 6.3:1 on bg.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary buttons).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Wrong letters (with a solid underline), missed-letter underlines, destructive actions. 6.5:1 and 4.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: error-extra
tokens.usage: Extra letters typed past the end of a word. Passage-size text only: 4.1:1 and 5.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: slip
tokens.usage: Accent slips (right letters, wrong or missing accent), always with a dotted underline; low-quota warning. 9.5:1 and 5.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Personal bests, Ready status, success toasts. 9.1:1 and 4.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline on every control: brand at 60%.

tokens.name: cover-bordeaux
tokens.usage: Generated book cover tint. Title in text on top (high contrast in both themes).

tokens.name: cover-ardoise
tokens.usage: Generated book cover tint (slate).

tokens.name: cover-sauge
tokens.usage: Generated book cover tint (sage).

tokens.name: cover-ocre
tokens.usage: Generated book cover tint (ochre).

styles.name: type-passage
styles.sample: Nous étions à l’Étude, quand le Proviseur entra
styles.usage: The text you type. Web: clamp(22px, 2.2vw + 8px, 32px); mobile 20–22px. Also lesson quotes in italic.

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: Result WPM and accuracy. Tabular digits.

styles.name: type-stat
styles.usage: Live stats, timers, keyboard hints. Tabular digits so numbers do not jump.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: He was about to go on, but his tongue went stiff.

styles.name: type-small
styles.usage: Labels, hints, book line under the passage.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap in a config-bar group; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; the minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (lg).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on web; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between the passage and the result card.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Baseline pitch of the cover rules; section gap on web.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top space above the passage on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Large page breaks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Landing hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, key caps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, the result card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, book covers, mobile sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: quota badge, status chips, avatar.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The only shadow: menus, dialogs, toasts. Everything else is flat.
